//: Loop settings for the plenipo-agents marketplace repo. Adapted from plugins/plenipo/skills/setup/assets/settings.json: the owner is substituted, and the dotnet/docker/aspire allows are dropped because this repo ships no application code. The deny list is unchanged — remove nothing from it. Every plugin is enabled because an unattended run cannot reload its own plugin set mid-flight; the cost is each skill's ~250-token description, and nothing else until a skill is invoked.
//self-reference: This repo IS the marketplace, so a session here loads the PUBLISHED skills, not the ones on disk. CLAUDE.md's warning applies: the skills in plugins/ are this repo's product, not its instructions. Do not follow a skill you are editing.

permissions.//: Allow what a tick in THIS repo genuinely needs, so a timer never blocks on a prompt nobody is there to answer. The two verifiers are `node eng/validate-marketplace.mjs` and `npx markdownlint-cli2`.
permissions.//deny: Deny beats allow, and these are the difference between a loop that can only propose and one that can destroy. Note what deny can and cannot see: it matches the Bash string, so it stops an improvised `gh pr merge` but NOT the merge inside `node .github/scripts/merge-gate.mjs --merge`. The authoritative control on merging is autonomy.level in workflow.json, which that script reads and refuses to exceed. Treat this list as the belt, not the braces, and remove nothing from it.
